rule.name: code-quality-security-gates
rule.description: MANDATORY — no skip. QA (quality gate phase) and secure must run and pass for greenfield and brownfield before deployment. Neither may be skipped.

pipeline_order.step: After code + tests; QA runs quality gate phase; before PR/deployment
After qa quality gate passes; before deploy (includes security assessment)

code_quality_gate.purpose: Focused, systematic review of code quality and maintainability. Assess: readability, modularity, adherence to patterns and standards, test coverage, complexity hot spots, refactoring opportunities. Output must clearly state PASS or FAIL. If FAIL: specify concrete improvements requiring return to Code before proceeding.
code_quality_gate.tools: SonarQube (SonarScanner CLI) or SonarCloud + language-specific linting (ESLint, Checkstyle, SpotBugs)
code_quality_gate.required_env: SONAR_TOKEN, SONAR_PROJECT_KEY, SONAR_HOST_URL (or https://sonarcloud.io for SonarCloud), SONAR_ORGANIZATION (SonarCloud only)
code_quality_gate.fallback: When SonarQube not configured: Lint + tests + coverage (per sprint workflow) must pass. Do not skip the qa quality gate phase — run it with fallback (lint + tests + coverage) and produce code-review.md. Document tool used in PR.
code_quality_gate.output: code-review.md with quality gate status, metrics, issues, remediation

security_review.purpose: Evaluate design and implementation from a security perspective. Identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, data protection gaps, compliance issues. Provide actionable recommendations. Clearly indicate whether security posture is acceptable. If critical: require return to code (and potentially plan) with explicit guidance.
security_review.greenfield: Required: npm audit / pnpm audit / pip audit (or project security scan). Optional: Veracode if credentials are configured.
security_review.brownfield: Required: Veracode Pipeline Scanner — VERACODE_API_ID, VERACODE_API_KEY, Java 11+ Required: Manual OWASP Top 10 review Output: security-review.md with Veracode results + manual findings
security_review.veracode_setup: Download pipeline-scan: https://downloads.veracode.com/securityscan/pipeline-scan-LATEST.zip Veracode scans compiled artifacts — build before scan (e.g., dist/ for TS, target/ for Java) Artifact: zip of compiled output (e.g., zip -r veracode-scan-artifact.zip dist/ -i "*.js")
security_review.owasp_focus: A01 Injection, A02 Broken Auth, A03 XSS, A05 Misconfiguration, A07 XSS, A09 Logging Failures

hitl_gates.gate: Code quality gate (qa phase): MUST run — cannot be skipped. User must confirm quality gate PASS before secure. FAIL → return to Code.
Security review (secure): MUST run — cannot be skipped. User must confirm Critical/High findings resolved before deployment. Unacceptable posture → return to Code/Plan.
Deployment: Do not deploy until both gates pass. No bypass.

rule.sprint_integration: Per sprint: Lint, tests, coverage (already in sprint workflow) Before deployment: Code quality gate (SonarQube) + Security review (Veracode for brownfield) PR per sprint: Human review gate
